title: iCARE pilot site setup
description: One site's shared study context. Complete before enrolling participants. Requirements are for this initialisation profile, not universal ontology restrictions.

schema_version.description: Input profile version; independent of the ontology version.

recorded_at.description: When these setup details were recorded; include Z or a UTC offset.

source.description: Who or what supplied the setup information, expressed as a short source description.

id.description: Study identifier, shared by its sites.

phases.description: Optional study phases available for enrolment.

arms.description: Optional study arms available for enrolment; listing an arm does not assign a participant.

id.description: Site identifier, unique within this output deployment.

language_tag.description: Site locale, e.g. es-ES. This profile accepts a language and country pair; it is not a participant preference.

country_code.description: Country code in ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 form, e.g. ES. Format is checked; no live ISO registry lookup is performed.

time_zone.description: IANA time zone, e.g. Europe/Madrid; checked against the runtime time-zone database.
